13008-the-edda-volume-2-the-heroic-mytho.description: A book by Winifred Faraday, M.A.. 12 of this series), and the chief question to be determined is whether they represent, however altered in form, a mythology common to all the Germans, and as such necessarily early; or whether they are in substance, as well as in form, a specific creation of the Scandinavians, and therefore late and secondary.

18125-the-audacious-war.title: The Audacious War
18125-the-audacious-war.creator: Clarence W. Barron
18125-the-audacious-war.description: A book by Clarence W. Barron. Peabody: "The English poets, Bridges, Kipling, Austin, and Noyes, have all tried to meet the need and all have lamentably failed. I am proud not only that an American, but that a Harvard man, should have risen to the occasion."

35164-the-secret-battle.title: The Secret Battle
35164-the-secret-battle.creator: Unknown
35164-the-secret-battle.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ow waters with the pink and white houses hiding under the hills; Gibraltar Town shimmering and asleep in the noonday sun; Malta and the bumboat women, carozzes swaying through the narrow, chattering streets; cool drinks at cafés in a babel of strange tongues; all these were to Penrose part of the authentic glamour of the East; and he said so.

67269-against-the-tide.title: Against The Tide
67269-against-the-tide.creator: Unknown
67269-against-the-tide.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The wedding was yet some little distance away. Macgowan, who had been dressing for his part of best man and who was a house guest, crossed the upstairs hall toward the stairway, just as Dorothy herself appeared from a room which was aflutter with excited feminine voices. With the license of his age and position, he led her to the window-nook and began to speak of Armstrong.

arxiv-1906-00803.title: 54TH RENCONTRES DE MORIOND QCD AND HIGH ENERGY INTERACTIONS EXPERIMENTAL SUMMARY
arxiv-1906-00803.creator: Vincenzo M. Vagnoni
arxiv-1906-00803.description:
A 2019 arXiv research paper by Vincenzo M. Vagnoni. The conference included about 90 talks covering a plethora of different sectors, like Higgs physics, electroweak physics, top physics, BSM physics, soft QCD, jets, PDFs, heavy ions, heavy flavours, spectroscopy, etc. A few experimental results are here highlighted. 1
Introduction

The Standard Model of particle physics (SM) has been working beautifully, up to a few hundred GeV so far, yet we know that it must be an effective theory valid up to some energy scale.

arxiv-1909-11338.title: Cooperation in Microbial Populations: Theory and Experimental Model Systems
arxiv-1909-11338.creator: J. Cremer, A. Melbinger, K. Wienand, T. Henriquez, H. Jung, E. Frey
arxiv-1909-11338.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by J. Cremer, A. Melbinger, K. Wienand, T. Henriquez, H. Jung, E. Frey. Cooperative behavior, the costly provision of benefits to others, is common across all domains of life. This review article discusses cooperative behavior in the microbial world, mediated by the exchange of extracellular products called public goods. We focus on model species for which the production of a public good and the related growth disadvantage for the producing cells are well described.

arxiv-2201-09126.title: Formation and stability of vortex solitons in nematic liquid crystals
arxiv-2201-09126.creator: Pawel S. Jung, Yana V. Izdebskaya, Vladlen G. Shvedov, Demetrios N. Christodoulides, Wieslaw Krolikowski
arxiv-2201-09126.description: Abstract We study the propagation dynamics of bright optical vortex solitons in nematic liquid crystals with a nonlocal reorientational nonlinear response. We investigate the role of optical birefringence on the stability of these solitons. In agreement with recent experimental observations, we show that the birefringence-induced astigmatism can eventually destabilize these vortex solitons.

arxiv-2206-04737.title: Outsider Oversight: Designing a Third Party Audit Ecosystem for AI Governance Conference: Proceedings of the 2022 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society; August 1–3, 2022; Oxford, United Kingdom Proceedings of the 2022 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES’22), August 1–3, 202
arxiv-2206-04737.creator: Inioluwa Deborah Raji, Peggy Xu, Colleen Honigsberg, Daniel Ho
arxiv-2206-04737.description: Abstract . Much attention has focused on algorithmic audits and impact assessments to hold developers and users of algorithmic systems accountable. But existing algorithmic accountability policy approaches have neglected the lessons from non-algorithmic domains: notably, the importance of interventions that allow for the effective participation of third parties.

arxiv-2304-05669.title: Factorized Inverse Path Tracing for Efficient and Accurate Material-Lighting Estimation
arxiv-2304-05669.creator: Liwen Wu, Rui Zhu, Mustafa B. Yaldiz, Yinhao Zhu, Hong Cai, Janarbek Matai, Fatih Porikli, Tzu-Mao Li, Manmohan Chandraker, Ravi Ramamoorthi
arxiv-2304-05669.description: Abstract Inverse path tracing has recently been applied to joint material and lighting estimation, given geometry and multi-view HDR observations of an indoor scene. However, it has two major limitations: path tracing is expensive to compute, and ambiguities exist between reflection and emission.

arxiv-2305-16004.title: The Milstein scheme for singular SDEs with Hölder continuous drift
arxiv-2305-16004.creator: Máté Gerencsér , Gerald Lampl and Chengcheng Ling
arxiv-2305-16004.description: Abstract . We study the L p L^{p} rate of convergence of the Milstein scheme for SDEs when the drift coefficients possess only Hölder regularity. If the diffusion is elliptic and sufficiently regular, we obtain rates consistent with the additive case.

arxiv-2311-10531.title: A priori procedure to establish spinodal decomposition in alloys
arxiv-2311-10531.creator: Simon Divilov, Hagen Eckert, Cormac Toher, Rico Friedrich, Adam C. Zettel, Donald W. Brenner, William G. Fahrenholtz, Douglas E. Wolfe, Eva Zurek, Jon-Paul Maria, Nico Hotz, Xiomara Campilongo, Stefano Curtarolo
arxiv-2311-10531.description: Abstract Spinodal decomposition can improve a number of essential properties in materials, especially hardness. Yet, the theoretical prediction of the onset of this phenomenon (e.g., temperature) and its microstructure (e.g., wavelength) often requires input parameters coming from costly and time-consuming experimental efforts, hindering rational materials optimization. Here, we present a procedure where such parameters are not derived from experiments.

arxiv-2401-04260.title: Outflows Driven from a Magnetic Pseudodisk
arxiv-2401-04260.creator: Shantanu Basu, Mahmoud Sharkawi, Masahiro N. Machida
arxiv-2401-04260.description: Abstract Outflows play a pivotal role in star formation as one of its most visible markers and a means of transporting mass, momentum, and angular momentum from the infalling gas into the surrounding molecular cloud. Their wide reach (at least thousands of au) is a contrast to typical disk sizes ( ∼ 10 − 100 \sim 10-100 au).

arxiv-2406-05192.title: Revealing faint compact radio jets at redshifts above 5 with very long baseline interferometry
arxiv-2406-05192.creator: M. Krezinger , , ,, G. Baldini, M. Giroletti, T. Sbarrato, G. Ghisellini, G. Giovannini ,, T. An, K. É. Gabányi , , ,, S. Frey , ,
arxiv-2406-05192.description: Abstract Context. Over the past two decades, our knowledge of the high-redshift ( z > 5 ) (z>5) radio quasars has expanded, thanks to dedicated high-resolution very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) observations. Distant quasars provide unique information about the formation and evolution of the first galaxies and supermassive black holes in the Universe.

arxiv-2410-11835.title: Aligned Datasets Improve Detection of Latent Diffusion-Generated Images
arxiv-2410-11835.creator: Anirudh Sundara Rajan* Utkarsh Ojha* Jedidiah Schloesser Yong Jae Lee
arxiv-2410-11835.description: Abstract As latent diffusion models (LDMs) democratize image generation capabilities, there is a growing need to detect fake images. A good detector should focus on the generative model’s fingerprints while ignoring image properties such as semantic content, resolution, file format, etc.

arxiv-2411-09967.title: Properties of a kaon-condensed phase in hyperon-mixed matter with three-baryon forces
arxiv-2411-09967.creator: Takumi Muto
arxiv-2411-09967.description: Abstract Coexistent phase of kaon condensates and hyperons [( Y Y + K K ) phase] in beta equilibrium with electrons and muons is investigated as a possible form of dense hadronic phase with multi-strangeness. The effective chiral Lagrangian for kaon-baryon and kaon-kaon interactions is utilized within chiral symmetry approach in combination with the interaction model between baryons.

arxiv-2412-04897.title: Photothermal Expansion of Nanostructures in Photo-induced Force Microscopy
arxiv-2412-04897.creator: Shohely Tasnim Anindo, Daniela Täuber, Christin David
arxiv-2412-04897.description: Abstract Powerful mid-infrared illumination combined with mechanical detection via force microscopy provides access to nanoscale spectroscopic imaging in Materials and Life Sciences. Photo-induced force microscopy (PiFM) employs pulsed illumination and noncontact force microscopy resulting in unprecedented spatial and high spectral resolution.

arxiv-2503-03129.title: Exploring Neural Ordinary Differential Equations as Interpretable Healthcare classifiers
arxiv-2503-03129.creator: Shi Li
arxiv-2503-03129.description: Abstract Deep Learning has emerged as one of the most significant innovations in machine learning. However, a notable limitation of this field lies in the “black box" decision-making processes, which have led to skepticism within groups like healthcare and scientific communities regarding its applicability.

arxiv-2510-14727.title: The Pursuit of Diversity: Multi-Objective Testing of Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents
arxiv-2510-14727.creator: Antony Bartlett, Cynthia Liem, Annibale Panichella
arxiv-2510-14727.description: Abstract Testing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents in safety-critical domains requires discovering diverse failure scenarios. Existing tools such as INDAGO rely on single-objective optimization focused solely on maximizing failure counts, but this does not ensure discovered scenarios are diverse or reveal distinct error types.

arxiv-2511-11167.title: NJL-Chiral Soliton and the Nucleon Equation of State at supra-saturation density: Impact of Chiral Symmetry Restoration
arxiv-2511-11167.creator: Bikram Keshari Pradhan, Guy Chanfray, Hubert Hansen, Jérôme Margueron
arxiv-2511-11167.description: Abstract It has been conjectured that, at sufficiently high baryon densities, the equation of state (EoS) of bulk nuclear matter can be identified with that of the nucleon core. In this work, we illustrate how the energy density and pressure distributions inside individual nucleons can be utilized to construct the EoS of supra-dense matter.

arxiv-2512-20577.title: Improving ML Training Data with Gold-Standard Quality Metrics Conference: KDD ’19: 25th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 05, 2019; Anchorage, AK KDD ’19: 25th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, August 05, 2019, Anchorage, AK CCS: Computi
arxiv-2512-20577.creator: Leslie Barrett, Michael W. Sherman
arxiv-2512-20577.description: Abstract . Hand-tagged training data is essential to many machine learning tasks. However, training data quality control has received little attention in the literature, despite data quality varying considerably with the tagging exercise. We propose methods to evaluate and enhance the quality of hand-tagged training data using statistical approaches to measure tagging consistency and agreement.

arxiv-2601-08666.title: Blind Deconvolution in Astronomy: How Does a Standalone U-Net Perform?
arxiv-2601-08666.creator: Jean-Eric Campagne
arxiv-2601-08666.description: Abstract Aims: This study investigates whether a U-Net architecture can perform standalone end-to-end blind deconvolution of astronomical images without any prior knowledge of the Point Spread Function (PSF) or noise characteristics. Our goal is to evaluate its performance against the number of training images, classical Tikhonov deconvolution and to assess its generalization capability under varying seeing conditions and noise levels.

arxiv-2603-19802.title: Evaluating Vision Foundation Models for Pixel and Object Classification in Microscopy
arxiv-2603-19802.creator: Carolin Teuber, Anwai Archit, Tobias Boothe, Peter Ditte, Jochen Rink, Constantin Pape

pmc-10603129.title: A modified particle swarm optimization algorithm for a vehicle scheduling problem with soft time windows
pmc-10603129.creator: Jinwei Qiao, Shuzan Li, Ming Liu, Zhi Yang, Jun Chen, Pengbo Liu, Huiling Li, Chi Ma
pmc-10603129.description: This article constructed a vehicle scheduling problem (VSP) with soft time windows for a certain ore company. VSP is a typical NP-hard problem whose optimal solution can not be obtained in polynomial time, and the basic particle swarm optimization(PSO) algorithm has the obvious shortcoming of premature convergence and stagnation by falling into local optima.

pmc-10628997.title: Biomarkers to Improve Decision-making in Acute Heart Failure
pmc-10628997.creator: Rafael de la Espriella, Gonzalo Núñez-Marín, Pau Codina, Julio Núñez, Antoni Bayés-Genís
pmc-10628997.description: Acute heart failure (AHF) is a complex clinical syndrome that requires prompt diagnosis, risk stratification and effective treatment strategies to reduce morbidity and mortality. Biomarkers are playing an increasingly important role in this process, offering valuable insights into the underlying pathophysiology and facilitating personalised patient management.

pmc-10735606.title: INTERSECTIONAL AND BIOSOCIAL PATHWAYS TO COGNITIVE FUNCTION AMONG OLDER HISPANICS AND LATINOS
pmc-10735606.creator: Catherine Garcia, Lauren Brown
pmc-10735606.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Hispanics/Latinos are the fastest-growing segment of older adults in the United States (U.S.). They are at high risk for cognitive impairment (CI) and Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD). While increased research attention has been given to the socioeconomic and cultural factors that influence the prevention, diagnosis, and care provided to Hispanics/Latinos with CI and ADRD, there are still theoretical and methodological gaps in clarifying the mechanisms and pathways that produce ADRD inequities, including life course and multilevel mechanisms.

pmc-11394022.title: CSF1R Ligands Expressed by Murine Gliomas Promote M-MDSCs to Suppress CD8+ T Cells in a NOS-Dependent Manner
pmc-11394022.creator: Gregory P Takacs, Julia S Garcia, Caitlyn A Hodges, Christian J Kreiger, Alexandra Sherman, Jeffrey K Harrison, Antonio Giuseppe Naccarato, Andres Martin Acosta, Giuseppe Fanelli
pmc-11394022.description: Simple SummaryCurrently, there are no effective therapies for glioblastoma. Infiltrating myeloid cells contributes significantly to the immune suppressive tumor microenvironment that is characteristic of GBM. Monocytic myeloid-derived suppressor cells are chief immune suppressive cells found in the glioma microenvironment. Understanding the mechanisms of M-MDSC differentiation and T-cell suppression is imperative for generating therapies that target this tumor-supportive cell population.

pmc-11413004.title: Dexamethasone acetate loaded poly(ε-caprolactone) nanofibers for rat corneal chemical burn treatment
pmc-11413004.creator: Da Ran Kim, Sun-Kyoung Park, Eun Jeong Kim, Dong-Kyu Kim, Young Chae Yoon, David Myung, Hyun Jong Lee, Kyung-Sun Na
pmc-11413004.description: Topical eye drop approaches to treat ocular inflammation in dry eyes often face limitations such as low efficiency and short duration of drug delivery. Nanofibers serve to overcome the limitation of the short duration of action of topical eye drops used against ocular inflammation in dry eyes.

pmc-11473781.creator: Alishbah Saddiqa, Mahrukh Zakir, Mawara Sheikh, Zahid Muneer, Arsalan Hassan, Iqra Ali, Ihtisham Ul Haq, Azmat Ali Khan, Abdul Malik, Abdul Rauf Siddiqi

pmc-11550051.title: A host immune-related LncRNA and mRNA signature as a discriminant classifier for bacterial from non-bacterial sepsis in children
pmc-11550051.creator: Chunxia Wang, Ting Sun, Yiping Zhou, Tiantian Liu, Shuyun Feng, Xi Xiong, Jiao Fan, Qiming Liang, Yun Cui, Yucai Zhang
pmc-11550051.description: BackgroundThe variations in non-coding RNA alterations and the host immune response between patients with bacterial and non-bacterial sepsis, along with their clinical characteristics, are largely unknown.MethodsThe landscape of long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) and mRNA in whole blood cells from pediatric patients with bacterial sepsis or non-bacterial sepsis were characterized using an Arraystar human LncRNA microarray.

pmc-12471115.title: Metabolic Syndrome Clusters and Arterial Stiffness: Unraveling Early Predictors of Cardiovascular Risk in a Follow-Up Study
pmc-12471115.creator: Agnė Jucevičienė, Ligita Ryliškytė, Jolita Badarienė, Aleksandras Laucevičius, Ha Won Kim
pmc-12471115.description: Background: The aim of this study was to assess the association between different metabolic syndrome (MetS) component clusters, arterial stiffness as measured by aortic pulse wave velocity (aPWV) and cardio-ankle vascular index (CAVI), and the incidence of major cardiovascular events during long-term follow-up.

pmc-12649723.title: Antimicrobial Resistance Trends, Resistance Mechanisms, and Antibiotic Consumption in COVID-19 Versus Non-COVID-19 Units: A Seven-Year Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12649723.creator: Stefan Porubcin, Alena Rovnakova, Ondrej Zahornacky, Pavol Jarcuska
pmc-12649723.description: Background: The COVID-19 pandemic profoundly affected healthcare delivery and antibiotic prescribing, raising concerns about increasing antimicrobial resistance. This study investigated seven-year trends in bacterial resistance, underlying resistance mechanisms, and antibiotic consumption in COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 units at a tertiary hospital in Slovakia. Methods: A retrospective cohort analysis (2018–2024) was conducted using clinical isolates of Klebsiella sp., Acinetobacter sp., and P.

pmc-12711725.title: The comprehensive oral microbiome landscape unveils its interplay with poor oral health in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma risk
pmc-12711725.creator: Peipei Gao, Huangbo Yuan, Zhendong Mei, Xiaolin Yin, Yixin Zeng, Zhenqiu Liu, Xiaorong Yang, Jiangli Xue, Zidong Liu, Yanfeng Jiang, Weimin Ye, Ming Lu, Chen Suo, Xingdong Chen
pmc-12711725.description: SummaryGrowing evidence links poor oral health to an increased esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) risk, with the oral microbiome recognized as a key contributor. However, human-based evidence remains limited. Here, we analyze salivary shotgun metagenomic data from 390 ESCC case-control pairs and 16S rRNA sequencing data from 206 incident esophageal cancer (EC) case-control pairs.

pmc-13542155.title: Targeting mitophagy for neuroprotection: mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities
pmc-13542155.creator: Jiahui Yang, Jianfeng Li, Xintong Hou, Yifei Zheng, Zeyu Zhao, Ting Zhou, Tongwei Jing, Jiming Kong, Guohui Zhang, Ying Guo
pmc-13542155.description: Mitochondria are essential for neuronal energy production, cellular homeostasis, and overall neuronal function. Due to their high metabolic demands and limited regenerative capacity, neurons are particularly vulnerable to mitochondrial dysfunction, which leads to ATP depletion, excessive reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, and calcium imbalance—ultimately causing oxidative stress, metabolic disruption, and neuronal death.

pmc-13644479.title: Perovskite fluid dynamics
pmc-13644479.creator: Changshun Chen, Yingdong Xia, Yonghua Chen
pmc-13644479.description: The phase transition of perovskite thin films is inherently rapid and highly sensitive to multiple factors. Fluid dynamics has emerged as a powerful framework for elucidating the crystallization and phase transformation processes in perovskites. It governs solute transport, energy dissipation pathways, and mass transfer efficiency, thereby exerting a significant influence on nucleation behavior and crystal growth dynamics.
